    Path data on a quotient by a two-sided ideal #

    The version of Section3/SubQuiver.lean for plain path data: given path data in A and a two-sided ideal I, the vertices and arrows outside I form a quiver, and their images give path data in A ⧸ I (subPathData) with path values the images of the original ones (subPathData_pval). Every path outside I lifts (exists_lift).
